data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Cost Analysis for Optimization
features.description: Implement cost analysis features to optimize pipeline execution costs.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view cost breakdowns for pipeline executions.
The system suggests cost-saving opportunities based on analysis.
Users can simulate cost impacts of potential optimizations.

features.title: Execution Time Analysis
features.description: Provide detailed analysis of pipeline execution times to identify bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view average execution times for pipelines.
The system identifies and highlights execution bottlenecks.
Users can compare execution times across different pipeline runs.

features.title: Interactive Jupyter Notebook Integration
features.description: Develop an interactive Jupyter notebook to visualize and analyze pipeline execution data.
acceptance_criteria: Users can load pipeline execution data into the notebook.
The notebook provides interactive visualizations of pipeline metrics.
Users can modify and rerun analysis cells within the notebook.

features.title: Success Rate Analysis
features.description: Analyze and report on the success rates of pipeline executions.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view success rates for individual pipelines.
The system provides alerts for pipelines with declining success rates.
Users can access historical success rate data.

features.title: Pipeline Performance Trend Analysis
features.description: Implement functionality to analyze and display trends in pipeline performance over time.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view historical trends of pipeline execution metrics.
The system highlights significant changes in performance trends.
Users can filter trend data by specific time periods.
